text:
Luca B: Heads-up — noticed a strange failure in our pnpm monorepo after the last SDK publish. samples/web-playground and an internal CLI both started failing with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED and some SSR builds complain about missing default export.

Hannah Y: Which publish? and what's the exact error?

Luca B: 3.2.1. Error from server logs: `Error [ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED]: Package subpath './package.json' is not defined by "exports" in /workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk-js/package.json` and the Next SSR server shows `SyntaxError: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk-js/dist/index.js' does not provide an export named 'default'`.

Sam R: Sounds like two things collided: we removed package.json subpath from exports and also removed the CJS/require conditional. pnpm's hoisting and some bundlers need the ./package.json export to inspect metadata at build time.

Hannah Y: Confirmed — pnpm + Node ESM loader tries to import package.json in some bundling flows. Removing that subpath breaks it. Also a bunch of legacy apps still do `const sdk = require('@redwood/sdk-js')` or `import sdk from` which expects default interop.

Ops Bot: CI alerted: samples/web-playground (pnpm) failed on 3.2.1 publish — https://ci.redwood/9999/build/88. Automated scan flagged 14 repos importing via require.

Typecheck Bot: Type errors observed in projects using `import SDK from '@redwood/sdk-js'`: "Could not find default export in module" and `TS7016: Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/sdk-js'.`

Luca B: I grabbed the installed package.json exports blob from node_modules: {".": {"import":"./esm/index.mjs","types":"./types/index.d.ts"},"./*":"./*"} — no `./package.json`, no `require` conditional.

Sam R: Proposed immediate fixes: (1) re-add "./package.json": "./package.json" to exports to satisfy pnpm and tools; (2) add conditional "require" -> `./cjs/index.cjs` under `.` so require() uses a CJS build; (3) provide a d.ts shim that offers default/export= interop for TS consumers.

Hannah Y: Agreed. Also add a smoke test in SDK CI that runs a pnpm workspace install + simple Webpack build, and a Node require test across node 12/14/16. That would have caught this.

Luca B: I'll open a patch PR with the compat changes and a canary publish flow: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/512 (WIP). The plan: patch -> canary tag `canary/exports-compat` -> run samples CI -> promote.

Ops Bot: Canary publish queued for PR 512: cb-canary-512. Notifying owners of affected repos.

Typecheck Bot: Also include `typesVersions` fallback for older TS consumers or add a small bundled `index.d.ts` that contains `declare const SDK: any; export default SDK; export = SDK;` so both `import` and `require` shapes work.

Sam R: Long term we should add a preflight checklist before changing exports: run pnpm, bun, Cloudflare Workers (wrangler), Next.js SSR, electron + pnpm, and verify package.json subpath behavior. I'll add an MR template note.

Hannah Y: For now let's get the compat patch out quickly. I'll review PR 512 and coordinate the canary runs. If canary passes, we should message #devex and customer-success so folks can pin/remove pins accordingly.

Luca B: Thanks — will include changelog note and a brief migration snippet in docs explaining safe import patterns and why exports were tightened and how we restored compat for interop. :white_check_mark:
